description:
Today's latest news headlines from public broadcasters and newspapers, newest first: title, source, time, short excerpt and link.
Use when: you need current events, "what's in the news today", or the latest headlines on a topic.
Topics (English): world, business, technology, science, health, sport, asia, africa, americas, middle_east. Languages (22): en, fr, nl, de, es, it, pt, ja, zh, ko, ar, hi, ru, tr, pl, id, sw, fa, uk, vi, ur, bn.
Example: {"topic":"technology","lang":"en","results":10}

country.description: Optional two-letter country code (BR, JP, US, IN…): national publishers of that country first; also sets the language when lang is omitted

topic.description: News section. Sections other than world exist in English only.

name: news_headlines
